name: rule 1 stops refusing a missing falsifier
the falsifier check stops stripping, so whitespace passes as a claim
expect: ...and a whitespace-only falsifier is refused too — not just the empty string

name: the group-size floor drops to one, so an item becomes a group
expect: a group with one open member is refused

name: the size floor counts MEMBERS rather than OPEN members
edits: live = [n for n in members if n in open_nums]
expect: ...and the count in the message is the OPEN count, not the member count

name: rule 3 stops noticing a member that is not a row
expect: a member that is not a row at all is refused

name: one item claimed by two groups is no longer reported
edits:
if n in seen:
                dupes.append(f"#{n} is claimed by both {seen[n]!r} and {title!r}")

if False:
                dupes.append(f"#{n} is claimed by both {seen[n]!r} and {title!r}")
expect: one item claimed by two groups is reported

name: the status cell is read one column too far left, breaking the narrow table
expect: a six-column closed row is read as closed

name: a three-field group crashes the rules instead of being reported
edits:
if len(g) != 4:
            out.append(f"{_name(g)}: has {len(g)} field(s), not 4 — the shape is "
                       f"(title, framing, falsifier, members)")
            continue

if False:
            out.append(f"{_name(g)}: has {len(g)} field(s), not 4 — the shape is "
                       f"(title, framing, falsifier, members)")
            continue
expect: a three-field group is reported as a shape error, not an exception
